title: She said that ... He told me that ...
summary: Косвенная речь: как пересказать чужие слова — глагол сдвигается в прошлое (am → was, will → would), и разница между **say** и **tell**.
ru:
## Как пересказать чужие слова
Когда мы передаём, что сказал другой человек, глагол обычно «сдвигается» на шаг в прошлое. Сравните прямую речь и пересказ.
> Diane: «I'm enjoying my new job.» → Diane said (that) she **was enjoying** her new job. — Диана сказала, что ей нравится новая работа.
> Tom: «I live in Osh.» → Tom said he **lived** in Osh.
> Anna: «I don't like my job.» → Anna said she **didn't like** her job.

## Что во что превращается
| Было | Стало |
|---|---|
| am / is → | was |
| are → | were |
| do / does → | did |
| have / has → | had |
| will → | would |
| can → | could |
| -ing (is doing) → | was doing |
| глагол (work) → | worked |

> Steve: «I'll phone you.» → Steve said he **would** phone me.
> Ann: «I can't find a job.» → Ann said she **couldn't** find a job.
> Peter: «I have to go early.» → Peter said he **had to** go early.
Местоимения тоже меняются по смыслу: «I'm tired» → She said **she** was tired.

## say и tell
- **tell** всегда с тем, кому говорят: **told me / told Ann**.
- **say** — без адресата: **said that ...**; если нужен адресат, то **say to**.
> He **told me** that he was tired. = He **said** that he was tired.
> What did she **say to you**? — What did she **tell you**?
- ~~He said me that ...~~ → He **told me** that ... / He **said** that ...
- ~~He told that he was tired.~~ → He **said** that he was tired.
- ~~I told to Ann.~~ → I **told Ann**.

## Слово that можно опустить
> Ann told me **that** she didn't like her job. = Ann told me she didn't like her job.

## Типичные ошибки
В русском времена в пересказе не сдвигаются («Он сказал, что **устал**»), а в английском сдвигаются: He said he **was** tired.
en:
## Reporting what people say
When we report what somebody said, the verb usually goes one step back into the past.
> Diane: 'I'm enjoying my new job.' → Diane said (that) she **was enjoying** her new job.
> Tom: 'I live in Osh.' → Tom said he **lived** in Osh.
> Anna: 'I don't like my job.' → Anna said she **didn't like** her job.

## Changes
| Direct | Reported |
|---|---|
| am / is | was |
| are | were |
| do / does | did |
| have / has | had |
| will | would |
| can | could |
| is doing | was doing |
| work | worked |

> Steve: 'I'll phone you.' → Steve said he **would** phone me.
> Ann: 'I can't find a job.' → Ann said she **couldn't** find a job.
> Peter: 'I have to go early.' → Peter said he **had to** go early.
Pronouns change too: 'I'm tired' → She said **she** was tired.

## say and tell
- **tell** needs a person: **told me / told Ann**.
- **say** has no person after it: **said that ...** (or **say to** somebody).
> He **told me** that he was tired. = He **said** that he was tired.
> What did she **say to you**? = What did she **tell you**?
- ~~He said me that ...~~ → He **told me** that ...
- ~~He told that he was tired.~~ → He **said** that he was tired.

## That is optional
> Ann told me **that** she didn't like her job. = Ann told me she didn't like her job.
structure:
## Сдвиг времён
| Прямая речь | Косвенная речь |
|---|---|
| I **am** busy. | She said she **was** busy. |
| We **are** late. | They said they **were** late. |
| I **work** here. | He said he **worked** there. |
| I **don't know**. | She said she **didn't know**. |
| I **have** a car. | He said he **had** a car. |
| I **will** call. | She said she **would** call. |
| I **can** swim. | He said he **could** swim. |
| I'm **working**. | She said she **was working**. |

## say и tell
| Глагол | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| said | said (that) + предложение | He said (that) he was ill. |
| said | said to + человек | She said to me ... |
| told | told + человек (that) + предложение | He told me (that) he was ill. |

## Памятка
> **tell** + человек всегда: *told me, told them, told Anna*.
> **say** — без человека: *said that*.

items.text: 'We are going to buy a flat.' → They said they {{were}} going to buy a flat.
'I don't like fish.' → Sara said she {{didn't|did not}} like fish.
'I'll help you.' → Mike said he {{would|'d}} help me.
'I can't come.' → Julia said she {{couldn't|could not}} come.
'I have a headache.' → Tim said he {{had}} a headache.
She {{told}} me that she was hungry.
What did the doctor {{say}} to you?
Ann {{said}} she didn't know the answer.
I {{told}} Tom that the shop was closed.

items.q: Peter: 'I'm very happy.' → Peter said he ___ very happy.
Anna: 'I will call you.' → Anna said she ___ call me.
My boss ___ me that I could go home.
She ___ that she liked the film.
Tom: 'I live in Kazan.' → Tom said he ___ in Kazan.
Kate: 'I can't swim.' → Kate said she ___ swim.
Как сказать «Он сказал мне, что устал»?
options: He said me that he was tired.
He told me that he was tired.
He told that he was tired.
items.why: tell + me, а say не принимает me напрямую.

options: What did she tell to you?

items.q: Как сказать «Она сказала, что у неё нет времени»?
options: She said she didn't have time.
She said she doesn't have time yesterday.
She told she didn't have time.
items.why: Сдвиг в прошлое; said без адресата.

items.q: Как сказать «Я сказал Ане, что опаздываю»?
options: I told to Ann I was late.
I said Ann I was late.
I told Ann I was late.

items.q: Как сказать «Они сказали, что будут здесь в пять»?
options: They said they would be here at five.
They said they will be here at five yesterday.
They told they would be here at five.
